record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 17.8: Read information off bar graphs

1a. School A started a recycling project. The bar chart below shows the number of kilograms of each category School A recycled last week.

School A's recycling

Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/sv-qb-jss1-17-0_007.png

Of which item did the school collect the most, in kilograms?
record.answer_text:
Find the category for which the school collected the most by finding the highest bar on the bar graph.

From the graph, we can see that more kilograms of plastic were collected than any other category. This is represented by the highest bar, which is 14 kg.

Answer: In kilograms, the item collected the most was plastic.
